messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — I put together a one-pager draft for Lumena's Q2 SLO alignment ahead of their renewal. Link: https://redwood.docs/lumena-q2-slo-draft :paperclip:

aj_sales: Thanks — can you call out renewal risk in the doc? Lumena's NRR is borderline; if we change credit exposure it affects MRR targets. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

maria_cs: Yep included a risk section. Key asks: confirm uptime SLO (we proposed 99.9% monthly), p95 latency for text gen vs embeddings (350ms embeddings p95, 250ms gen p95), and the credit calc method (monthly proportional credits once threshold hit).

devon_onboard: Do we have current onboarding status? last I saw they were in week 3 of integration and still missing metrics for prefix caching. Need to schedule enablement for their infra team.

maria_cs: Onboarding note: integration env stable, still waiting on their infra to enable KV cache. Proposed enablement session Thursday 10am PT. @devon_onboard can you run that?

devon_onboard: I can run it. Will send invite and a short checklist.

sanjay_ce: FYI Lumena asked about private VPC routing for EU region — that could affect latency targets. If they go private, we should update the SLO table to show region-specific p95s and a fallback policy.

kyra_support: Sharing recent incident snippet that impacted their p95 on 2026-02-14:
```
2026-02-14T08:23:12Z | model-node-3 | 503 | backpressure spike after batch window change
2026-02-14T08:24:05Z | router-1     | 200 | degraded p95 -> 720ms
```
We offered a goodwill credit per SLA.

aj_sales: Good to call that out. On the credit calc, propose simple tiered model: < 99.5% -> 5% credit, 99.5–99.9% -> 2% credit, < 99% -> escalate and custom remediation. Keeps legal+finance happy.

maria_cs: Sounds reasonable. I'll add the tiered table and sample math. Also adding rollout plan: canary for private routing and automatic fallback to hosted if p95 exceeds thresholds for 10m.

opsbot: Deployment notice: canary routing policy rolled out to staging at 2026-03-02T22:10:00Z. No errors reported. :robot_face:

maria_cs: Next steps: (1) @devon_onboard schedule enablement and share checklist, (2) @sanjay_ce update SLO table with region/private variants, (3) @aj_sales confirm credit tiers with finance, (4) I'll convert draft into a one-pager and share with Lumena CS lead by EOD Friday. Anyone want to present this on the renewal call? :eyes:

aj_sales: I can lead the renewal call but would like @maria_cs to cover SLO/credit details.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll prep slides and a single-slide incident timeline to explain past credit decisions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
